The difference of squares gives (513+487)(513−487) = 1000 × 26 = 26000.

Solution A computes 513+487 = 1000 and 513−487 = 26, giving 26000. Its intermediate split is a bit odd (500−400 + 13−87 = 100 − 74 = 26 is correct), and the result is right.

Solution B incorrectly computes 513+487 as 1026 (it adds 13 + 13 instead of cancelling +13 and −13), so its answer of 26676 is wrong.

WINNER: A
